The '''zeldrate''', also known as the '''zeldrate lizard''', was a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] predator that lived on the green plains of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. It fed mainly on the giant grazers known as [[bormu]], attacking those that roamed too far from their herds. Unlike their herbivorous counterpart, the zeldrates were small in number because of the Balmorran industries that hunted them for a caustic chemical secretion used as a cleaning solution for multiple industrial parts.<ref name="codex">{{TORcite|Zeldrate|type=codex}}</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces bombarded the surface of Balmorra, consequently destroying its industries. This led to both a decrease in the number of bormus, due to the contamination of the fields, and an increase of zeldrates, as the industries started operating below half capacity. With these variations, zeldrates fed on fewer bormus, forcing the predators to begin looking for new prey. They targeted [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings such as Imperial troops and resistance fighters, preying mostly on those who were wounded during battle.<ref name="codex" />

==Dantooine==
A population of zeldrates existed in the wild near the ruined [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="secrets">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref> around [[3626 BBY]]<ref name="enclavedate">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</ref>. A few of them were lost pets of [[Yarvok]].<ref name="secrets" /><ref name="invasive">{{TORcite|exp=ons|Invasive Species on Dantooine|type=codex}}</ref>

Zeldrates also populated<ref name="Geothermal">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|Geothermal Disruption|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> and were considered native<ref name="Brood Basin">{{TORcite|type=dynamic|Brood Basin|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> at the [[Jannimak crash site|territory]] where later crashed the [[research vessel]] [[Jannimak]]. One of the [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] zones that appeared after the crash, known as [[Geothermal Disruption]], a zone of acid lakes, attracted zeldrates, similarly to industrial wastes of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]] send in contractors to protect native zeldrates from the invasive embercralwers from the Jannimak.<ref name="Brood Basin" />
